author: swain
title: fix(gp-api): verify Clerk tokens locally with the instance public key
body:
gp-api verifies gp-marketing's M2M JWTs (and every user's session token) against Clerk's JWKS, and without a configured key the Clerk SDK caches that JWKS for only 5 minutes. Each task refetches it on the request path every 5 minutes, every request that arrives while the cache is stale fetches it again, and `clerkCall` rejects anything slower than 2s. The result is a steady trickle of 403s on healthy tasks: about 0.06% of gp-marketing's calls to prod before the 2026-10-19 cutover and 0.5% during a dev gp-marketing build, plus about 1,240 during that night's overload.

election-api solved this before the migration by passing the instance's PEM public key as `jwtKey`, and this does the same in gp-api, with the same keys. I checked them against the live instances: the dev key matches the JWKS behind gp-api's dev secret key, and the prod key matches `clerk.goodparty.org/.well-known/jwks.json`. The keys are public, so they live in the Pulumi env vars, not the secret. Previews use the dev instance.

Session `verifyToken` gets the same key, so user requests stop depending on Clerk's JWKS endpoint too. Opaque `mt_` M2M tokens still verify through Clerk's API; that path has no local option.

The tradeoff, same as election-api: if Clerk's signing key is ever rotated, tokens fail to verify until `CLERK_JWT_KEY` is updated here. This has to be live before gp-marketing moves election traffic to gp-api again, alongside #2984.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches authentication verification for all session and JWT-format M2M traffic; misconfigured or stale keys after Clerk rotation would reject valid tokens until deploy is updated.
> 
> **Overview**
> Configures **local Clerk JWT verification** by wiring the instance PEM public key (`CLERK_JWT_KEY`) through deploy, the env contract, the Clerk client factory, and `verifyToken` in `ClerkAuthService`.
> 
> **Deploy** sets per-environment public keys in plain ECS env vars (preview/dev share the dev Clerk instance; prod has its own). **Runtime** passes `jwtKey` into `createClerkClient` and session `verifyToken`, so user session JWTs and JWT-format M2M tokens no longer depend on Clerk’s JWKS endpoint on the request path. Opaque `mt_` M2M tokens are unchanged and still hit Clerk’s API.
> 
> This targets intermittent **403s** when JWKS cache expires (~5 minutes) and a refetch exceeds `clerkCall`’s 2s cap. **Docs** in `authentication/AGENTS.md` note the behavior and the rotation tradeoff: if Clerk rotates signing keys, `CLERK_JWT_KEY` must be updated before tokens verify again.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit e2b394895f220796a39f5be30a79b2e2a6072850. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
